# Signalith 0.3.2

- The HAProxy and keepalived samples in `deploy/loadbalancer` now check `/readyz` for syslog too (over TLS, TCP and UDP), so a server that is starting, stopping, drained or cut off from OpenSearch gets no syslog from the balancer. Copy the new checks into a balancer set up from the old samples. See [Load balancers](https://signalith.io/docs/load-balancers/).
